description:
Return the current prepaid credit balance for this AuditAE workspace, the price of one check on each engine, roughly how many checks the balance covers per engine, and the auto-refill setup.

Billing: free — works at a zero balance.

When to call: before a large paid run (get_share_of_voice across many prompts, crawl_site on 100 pages) to check it will fit, or after a tool returned out_of_credits.

Returns { balance_cents, balance_usd, available_cents, prices_cents_per_check, estimated_checks_left, auto_refill: { enabled, has_card, amount_cents, threshold_cents, monthly_cap_cents, cap_reached_this_month } | null, billing_url, free_today?: { google_data?: {used, of, then_cents}, technical_audit?: {used, of, then_cents} }, suggested_next?, next_step? }. available_cents is what a new paid run can use now (the balance less credit held by runs in flight); estimated_checks_left is based on it. billing_url is null for an agent workspace (use create_top_up_link). free_today is today's (UTC) use of the daily free allowances (Google data calls, single-page technical audits) and what each further one costs. When the credit can't cover one citation check and auto-refill is off, suggested_next is create_top_up_link for $10 (free to create; the user pays by card): relay it once.
name: get_balance
title: Get the workspace's AuditAE credit balance
